meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

howto.what: Claude 会把用户提出的前端需求转成可运行的代码。动手前先选定一个鲜明的视觉方向,再在字体、配色、动效等细节上落实,避免常见 AI 模板风。
howto.when: 当用户要求搭建网页组件、页面或应用界面,提出要构建的前端需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个复古未来风格的落地页,用独特的字体和进入动画。
say.note: Claude 会按这个方向生成完整可运行的页面代码。

say.text: 用 React 写一个极简风的博客首页,注意留白和排版。
say.note: 会得到一款符合该审美的 React 实现。

say.text: 给这个数据工具站设计一个工业风界面,加上纹理和滚动动效。
say.note: 会产出带视觉特征和交互动效的工具站代码。

howto.what_en: When given a frontend requirement, Claude first commits to a clear visual direction, then writes working code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue) with distinctive typography, color, and motion, and avoids generic AI-style defaults.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications and supplies the frontend requirements.

say_en.text: Build me a retro-futuristic landing page with distinctive fonts and entrance animations.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a complete runnable page in that direction.

say_en.text: Write a minimalist blog homepage in React, emphasizing whitespace and typography.
say_en.note: You will get a React implementation matching that aesthetic.

say_en.text: Design an industrial-style interface for this data tool with textures and scroll motion.
say_en.note: It outputs tool-site code with visual character and motion effects.
